items.summary: EMA has launched a new voluntary data submission (VDS) pilot to facilitate the sharing of data generated using New Approach Methodologies (NAMs). These innovative methods have…

items.summary: After Jenny Pearson’s daughter Elise first had a seizure at 16 months old, an MRI came back clean—her brain “looked beautiful,” Pearson recalled to Fierce. items.title: Ultragenyx fails phase 3 Angelman test, plots ‘significant expense reductions’
items.summary: Ultragenyx had been flying high after its recent FDA approval for Genglycos—but the company has been brought back down to earth with a damaging phase 3 flop.

items.title: Fresenius unit dinged in FDA warning letter flagging 'complaint trend' from customers
items.summary: Following a string of customer complaints, a Form 483 and a recall this past spring, a Fresenius manufacturing unit in Utah is contending with a warning letter from the FDA.

items.title: Novartis claims MS win as Rhapsido clears phase 3 with ‘no liver safety signal’
items.summary: Novartis appears to have broken the curse of the BTK inhibitor class. The Swiss pharma announced Tuesday that two phase 3 trials for Rhapsido in relapsing multiple sclerosis hit their goals without any liver safety flags.

items.title: New EU supply chain to end Visudyne shortage

items.title: AbbVie’s bispecific T-cell engager shows promise in ph. 3 multiple myeloma trial
items.summary: AbbVie released positive phase 3 data Thursday showing that its bispecific T-cell engager etentamig improved response rates and progression-free survival in patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.

items.title: TScan axes 75% of workforce to make room for solid tumor programs
items.summary: TCR-T specialist TScan Therapeutics will reduce its workforce by 75% following the pause of its hematological and autoimmune programs.

items.title: SEC, FDA sign info-sharing agreement as a ‘signal to the market’ on insider trading
items.summary: The SEC and the FDA have signed a three-year agreement to step up cooperation and information-sharing capabilities, aiming to improve each organization’s regulatory and enforcement missions.

items.title: From his parents’ basement to your medicine cabinet: Absci CEO endeavors to create biotech’s Apple
items.summary: The overwhelming demand for GLP-1 weight loss drugs has reshaped the drug market, empowering consumers to take charge of their own health and removing barriers between their wallets and their medicine cabinets.

items.title: ESC: Alnylam's next-gen silencer sees silver linings after fallout of AZ, Ionis trial in ATTR-CM
items.summary: As AstraZeneca appears to close the book on a combo approach following the phase 3 failure of its Ionis-partnered Wainua, several analysts contend it’s too early to count out Alnylam’s silencing drugs in ATTR-CM patients also taking standard-of-care stabilizers.

items.title: Alumis crushed by midstage lupus flop but plots path to phase 3 for TYK2 inhibitor
items.summary: A phase 2b lupus trial of Alumis’ envudeucitinib has missed its primary and secondary endpoints. But the biotech is still moving the TYK2 inhibitor into phase 3 in the autoimmune disease, pointing to evidence of efficacy in a prespecified subgroup of patients to support its decision.

items.title: FDA files reveal lingering concerns, contrasting views behind Replimune melanoma nod
items.summary: Two votes of confidence from leaders at the FDA’s Office of Clinical Evaluation and the Oncology Center of Excellence sealed Replimune’s fate, overruling review staffers’ concerns and paving the way for last month’s accelerated nod for Tudriqev.

items.title: Akeso, Summit’s ivonescimab extends lives in Keytruda head-to-head trial. What now?
items.summary: About two years ago, a head-to-head progression-free survival win made Akeso and Summit’s ivonescimab—and the PD-1xVEGF class—the most promising agent to replace Keytruda. Now, that same trial has met its overall survival endpoint, but to a far more measured reception.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: Another Tavneos domino falls as UK rescinds authorization
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

items.title: Pfizer offloads scrapped Seagen ADC to Medicus Pharma in up to $1B+ deal
items.summary: Pfizer has found a new home for an antibody-drug conjugate it acquired in its $43 billion Seagen buyout and dropped earlier this year.

items.title: Novartis Lp(a) drug fails to lower cardiovascular risk in closely watched ph. 3 trial
items.summary: Novartis’ Ionis-partnered drug designed to lower levels of Lp(a), a known cardiovascular risk factor, failed to reduce patients’ risk of a heart attack, stroke, or other major cardiovascular event in the first late-stage test for a drug meant to tackle the mysterious molecule.

items.title: Menarini signs $771M deal to take Gan & Lee GLP-1 to European market
items.summary: Italian company the Menarini Group has agreed to pay Chinese insulin maker Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals €62 million ($72 million) up front to collaborate on the registration and commercialization of Gan & Lee’s GLP-1 bofanglutide.

items.title: A year on from Big Pharma’s pull-back from the UK, has anything changed?
items.summary: September 2025 marked a low point for relations between the U.K. government and Big Pharma. Fierce reached out to the companies involved to see if they've softened their stance.

items.title: Chutes & Ladders—Invivyd's chairman adds CEO role ahead of COVID readout
items.summary: Infectious-disease biotech Invivyd has appointed its current chairman, Marc Elia, as CEO.

items.title: Psilocybin proves promising in neuropathic pain mouse study
items.summary: Amid the rise of psychedelics in the mental health space, researchers have begun to explore psilocybin as a treatment for chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy.

items.title: Why Roche is 'really excited' about a UCN2 analog for obesity after seeing preclinical data
items.summary: Roche has decided to pay $190 million upfront for an unusual obesity mechanism after viewing preclinical data that “clearly suggests” the modality can reduce weight while preserving lean muscle, Fierce has learned.

items.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: Superluminal snags $60M; AusperBio adds $120M
items.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.

items.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Novartis nixes Swiss site; TScan telegraphs 75% headcount drop
items.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

items.title: GSK pens $1.3B Hutchmed deal for early-stage KRAS-EGFR cancer asset
items.summary: GSK is handing over $110 million upfront to Hutchmed in a deal worth up to $1.295 billion to get its hands on a first-in-class oncology candidate.

items.title: Fortrea boosts early-phase CRO platform with $45M acquisition of Worldwide division
items.summary: Fortrea has agreed to acquire the early-phase services division of fellow CRO Worldwide Clinical Trials for $45 million.

items.title: Novartis telegraphs 130 job cuts amid biologics rethink in Switzerland
items.summary: Novartis could cut about 130 jobs in Switzerland as it rethinks its biologics technical development and production footprint in Basel.

items.title: Teva autoimmune antibody notches ph. 2 win in celiac disease
items.summary: Teva Pharmaceutical's dreams of a first-in-class autoimmune blockbuster are being kept alive after the Israeli outfit’s anti-interleukin-15 antibody scored a midstage win in celiac disease.

items.title: Novartis inks $3.2B subcutaneous drug delivery deal with Alteogen
items.summary: Novartis has struck a deal worth up to $3.2 billion to work with Alteogen on subcutaneous drug delivery, joining Biogen and GSK on the list of drugmakers to pay to access the technology this year.

items.title: Roche inks $1.53B deal for Simcere’s B-cell-targeting antibody
items.summary: Roche is paying oncology-focused Simcere Zaiming $75 million upfront for global rights to a preclinical trispecific antibody targeting B-cell-mediated diseases.

items.title: ArsenalBio sheds most of staff in pivot to in vivo CAR-T
items.summary: About a year after halving its staff in a clinical push, Arsenal Biosciences is now making a hard pivot that involves laying off most of its employees and seeking out new homes for its assets.

items.title: Medtronic recalls reflux monitoring device as 184 serious injuries linked to capsule
items.summary: Medtronic is recalling certain esophageal pH monitoring capsule delivery devices amid risks of them failing whilst deployed.

items.title: From Question to Action: Rethinking Pharma Engagement in the AI Era
items.summary: As AI reshapes health discovery, GoodRx is helping pharma turn consumer and HCP questions into action.

items.title: AZ leans on AI-generated llama to promote LAMA combo inhaler Breztri in new campaign
items.summary: The Breztri ad prompts viewers to "put a LAMA to work" by depicting an AI-generated llama and his barnyard colleagues working a late night in the office.

items.title: Daiichi unit American Regent recalls 3 epinephrine batches on particulate, leakage concerns
items.summary: Daiichi Sankyo subsidiary American Regent is launching a recall of three lots of generic epinephrine as it becomes one of the latest manufacturers to face headaches over particulate contamination in its drug products.

items.title: The people who stayed with the problem
items.summary: In this week’s episode of “The Top Line,” we look at the people who kept working the problem, from scientists pushing past long-standing limits in cancer and protein design to physicians and public health leaders tackling trust, misinformation, vaccine policy and representation in medicine.

items.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Novo's Wegovy pill, Lilly's Foundayo grow scripts
items.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

items.title: UCB’s Bimzelx comes from out of the blue to claim August’s top pharma ad spending spot
items.summary: Move over AbbVie and Johnson & Johnson, we have a new and surprising leading drug in the pharma ad spending space.

items.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Roche, GSK, Novartis billion-dollar deals; More MFN sign-ups; Akeso’s OS win
items.summary: GSK, Roche and Novartis continued their dealmaking spree with Asian companies. Three midsized Asian biopharmas reached MFN deals with the White House. Akeso and Summit's ivonescimab delivered a head-to-head overall survival win against Keytruda. And more.
